plan.coverage_explanation: Tests threshold-display stability when only measured distance changes, and restoration of the displayed threshold after two separate button presses, at three potentiometer settings. The initial mode, manual potentiometer-to-distance mapping, alarm comparison boundary, and buzzer behavior are unspecified. Consequently, this suite cannot independently require 15 at a predetermined time, require specific manual thresholds, or assert specific buzzer states. It does not claim complete mode-switching or alarm coverage.
assumptions: The bench default applies to D2: the button connects D2 to GND, uses INPUT_PULLUP, and is pressed at physical LOW.
A button press switches modes once; releasing it does not constitute another press.
With the potentiometer unchanged, returning to the same mode restores the same threshold.
Measured distance does not change the selected threshold displayed on the TM1637.

The initial mode and manual threshold mapping are missing. The reference chooses initial automatic mode and a linear integer mapping from ADC 0..1023 to 0..100 cm; checks do not require these choices.

Alarm polarity at the distance boundary, no-echo handling, and buzzer frequency/cadence are missing. The reference uses a continuous 1000 Hz passive-buzzer tone for valid distances strictly below the threshold and silence otherwise; checks do not require these choices.
